references.text: Here the parents of Moses are named: Amram took his aunt Jochebed as wife, and she bore him Aaron and Moses. This confirms the marriage between the man and woman from the tribe of Levi mentioned in Exodus 2:1.
The verse identifies Jochebed as a daughter of Levi, born in Egypt, and as the mother of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. This provides details about 'the daughter of Levi' mentioned in Exodus 2:1.
Here it is told how Levi was born and how he received his name. He is the ancestor of the tribe of Levi to which both of Moses' parents belonged.
Levi's sons are named: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari. Kohath was the grandfather of Moses, showing the lineage from Levi to Moses' father.
The genealogy of Levi shows the line from Levi through Kohath to Amram, who married Jochebed and became the father of Moses and Aaron.
Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ - By faith Moses was hidden by his parents for three months. This refers to the parents from the tribe of Levi mentioned in Exodus 2:1.
